t: Magnusson manual copper pipe cutter set provides precise and efficient cutting for both 15mm and 22mm copper pipe installations. The robust plumbing tool set comprises 2 essential pieces, engineered for reliable performance in various trade applications, including domestic and commercial heating and water systems. Each cutter features a durable aluminium construction with a sharp, fixed steel blade to ensure clean, accurate cuts. The ergonomic, slimline design offers an excellent grip and control; ideal for professional plumbers and installers working in confined or tight spaces where accuracy is paramount.
